items.title: Navy Athletics and Under Armour Unveil 2026 Army-Navy Uniform Honoring Naval Special Warfare
items.summary: ANNAPOLIS, Md. — Navy Athletics and Under Armour unveiled the 2026 Army-Navy football uniform, honoring the extraordinary history, heritage and sacrifice of the men and women of Naval Special Warfare (NSW), including the Navy SEALs, Special Warfare Combatant-Craft Crewmen (SWCC) and the pioneering Underwater Demolition Teams (UDT) that laid the foundation for modern Naval Special Warfare.

items.title: Navy Quarterback Jackson Gutierrez Named One of 30 Quarterbacks in Contention for the 2026 Davey O'Brien National Quarterback Award
items.summary: FORT WORTH, Texas (Nov. 10, 2026) — The Davey O'Brien Foundation unveiled the Davey O'Brien QB Class of 2026 today, a group that includes 30 players from across the nation who are now officially in contention for the 2026 Davey O'Brien National Quarterback Award.

items.title: 2027 Army-Navy Game Presented by USAA Moved to Dec. 4
items.summary: ANNAPOLIS, Md. — The Naval Academy Athletic Association and the Army West Point Athletic Association announced today that the 2027 Army-Navy Game presented by USAA, the 128th playing of America's Game, will be played Saturday, Dec. 4, at Lincoln Financial Field in Philadelphia.  It will mark the 91st playing of the game in Philadelphia.

items.title: Gutierrez Accounts for Six Touchdowns as Navy Holds Off Temple, 42-35
items.summary: ANNAPOLIS, Md. — Junior quarterback Jackson Gutierrez rushed for 180 yards and a career-high five touchdowns and threw for another score as Navy overcame a furious second-half comeback by Temple to defeat the Owls 42-35 Saturday afternoon before 31,132 at Navy-Marine Corps Memorial Stadium.
